title: Gamma Review (2026)
intro: Gamma is evaluated here as an AI presentation and document generator — Gamma is an AI presentation and document platform that generates slide decks, docs, and webpages from prompts. Free covers basic creation with limits. Plus is $8/mo on annual billing ($10/mo monthly) for premium AI models, branding removal, and expanded exports. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology (ease of use, AI job fit, output quality, workflow depth, integrations, governance/privacy, scalability, value, model capability), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Gamma when AI-generated presentations and documents are the primary job — not when you need voice production or full websites.
verdict: Choose Gamma when AI-generated presentations and documents are the primary job — not when you need voice production or full websites. Compare Wegic for website building, AdCreative.ai for ad creative, and ChatGPT if you need general LLM chat instead of deck generation. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, usage caps and credit rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Gamma's prompt-to-deck flow is fast for non-designers — minimal PowerPoint skills required. Score from first-party positioning, not lab testing.
Primary job is AI presentation/document generation — excellent ai-presentations cluster fit. Not scored as an LLM peer.
Generated decks and docs are polished for SMB marketing and founder pitches — strong within presentation cluster, held below flagship LLM reasoning.
Templates, themes, and export options cover presentation workflows — narrower than full work OS or agent-builder depth.
Google Workspace and basic connectors cover common sharing; ecosystem is lighter than LLM or marketing suites.
Consumer/SMB posture adequate for pitch decks and marketing collateral — not enterprise LLM governance depth.
Free → Plus supports individuals and small teams; lacks seat-based enterprise admin at scale.
Plus at $8/mo annual is excellent value for AI deck generation vs hiring design time — strong value in cluster. Affiliate economics excluded.
Presentation-focused AI models — capable for deck generation but not general reasoning flagship models.
